scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi, I recently submitted an FHA loan application for a home purchase, requesting $255,000 over 360 months. I haven’t received any update yet—can you tell me the current status or outcome of my application?
dialogue.agent: Thank you for reaching out. Your FHA loan application for a home purchase was approved and resulted in a finalized loan. After closing, your loan was purchased by Ginnie Mae. If you have any specific questions about your loan terms or next steps, please let me know.

dialogue.user:
Thank you for letting me know my loan was approved and purchased by Ginnie Mae. 

Could you please tell me the interest rate that’s been assigned to my loan, and are there any high-cost (HOEPA) or negative amortization flags on this loan?
dialogue.agent: Your loan has an interest rate of 5.75%. It is not classified as a high-cost mortgage under HOEPA, and there are no negative amortization features on your loan.

dialogue.user: Thank you for clarifying those details. Can you tell me what my total loan costs are, and what my recorded debt-to-income ratio means for my application?
dialogue.agent: Your total loan costs are $7,677.86. Regarding your debt-to-income (DTI) ratio, the record does not include a DTI value for your application, so I’m unable to provide that information. The DTI ratio typically reflects the percentage of your monthly income used to pay debts, but in your case, it was not recorded in the file.

dialogue.user:
Thank you for checking. That answers my questions. I appreciate the clear responses and explanation about the DTI.

<Satisfied> — The agent provided all the information I asked for in a clear, professional manner, and explained when something wasn’t available in the record. I feel well informed about my loan terms and status.
